sizing_specs:
Proximal Size (F): 2.7
Distal Size (F): 2.4
Catheter Working Length (cm): 162
indications:
The Microcatheter is indicated for use in the selective
placement of devices and/or fluids, such as contrast
media, into the peripheral, coronary, and neuro
vasculature during diagnostic and/or therapeutic
procedures.
